default.title: Warehouse operations and reliable POS posting
default.summary: ClawPilot now carries warehouse work through receiving, shipment, printing, carrier billing, settlement, and editable topology while giving Toast accounting an actionable posting queue with correct future-order and Payment Exceptions handling.
features: Editable warehouse, location, receiving, shipment, label, packing-slip, print-agent, carrier-billing, GL-coding, and settlement workflows
A POS posting queue with Ready, Hold, Posting, Posted, and Failed states, issue-only filtering, exact blocker details, and corrective actions
Toast future-order accounting that records payment-day Payment Exceptions and releases them when the order is fulfilled
Restaurant-business-date-aware payment classification and a bounded replay that discovers existing future preorders
fixes: Late-night Toast payments now follow paidBusinessDate instead of being shifted by calendar midnight
Open checks, out-of-balance journals, missing mappings, incomplete batch details, protected updates, stale workers, and provider failures can no longer disappear from the posting queue
Payment-only preorder dates no longer create empty QuickBooks Sales Receipts
Sandbox carrier-rate diagnostics remain scoped to their exact account and evidence boundary
